# Cold War Project: decolonization in Africa, progress bars (generated by gen_africa.py in the decolonization thread's scratchpad; edit freely)

### Gold Coast: self-government (0 to 100)
cwp_gold_self_rule_bar = {
	name = "cwp_gold_self_rule_bar"
	desc = "cwp_gold_self_rule_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes

	start_value = 10
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "cwp_gold_bar_nationalists"
			value = 0.2
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GLC ?= { has_variable = cwp_gold_positive_action }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_gold_bar_positive_action"
				value = 1
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_gold_constitution }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_gold_bar_constitution"
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_gold_detentions }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_gold_bar_detentions"
				value = -1.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_metropole_anticolonial_government"
				value = 0.4
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:HND ?= { is_subject = no }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_gold_bar_india"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 2
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_rising"
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_strong"
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
	}
}

### Kenya: Land and Freedom (insurgency 0 to 100) and settler power (0 to 100)
cwp_kenya_insurgency_bar = {
	name = "cwp_kenya_insurgency_bar"
	desc = "cwp_kenya_insurgency_bar_desc"
	default_bad = yes

	start_value = 0
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "cwp_kenya_bar_land_hunger"
			value = 0.3
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 1
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_rising"
				value = 0.2
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_strong"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:KKY ?= { has_variable = cwp_kenya_land_and_freedom }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_bar_forest_fighters"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_kenya_emergency }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_bar_emergency"
				value = -2
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_kenya_land_reform }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_bar_land_reform"
				value = -0.5
			}
		}
	}
}

cwp_kenya_settler_bar = {
	name = "cwp_kenya_settler_bar"
	desc = "cwp_kenya_settler_bar_desc"
	default = yes

	start_value = 85
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { cwp_has_anticolonial_leaning_government = yes }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_metropole_anticolonial_government_will"
				value = -0.4
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { cwp_has_imperialist_leaning_government = yes }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_metropole_imperialist_government_will"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 2
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_rising"
				value = -0.4
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_kenya_insurgency_level
				global_var:cwp_kenya_insurgency_level >= 1
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_settler_insurgency"
				value = -0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_kenya_emergency }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_settler_emergency_scandal"
				value = -0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GBR ?= { has_variable = cwp_kenya_land_reform }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_kenya_settler_land_reform"
				value = -0.3
			}
		}
	}
}

### Belgian Congo: the evolues' demands (0 to 100)
cwp_congo_demands_bar = {
	name = "cwp_congo_demands_bar"
	desc = "cwp_congo_demands_bar_desc"
	default_green = yes

	start_value = 5
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "cwp_congo_bar_evolues"
			value = 0.3
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 2
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_rising"
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_strong"
				value = 0.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:GLC ?= { is_subject = no }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_congo_bar_ghana"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:CNG ?= { has_variable = cwp_congo_riots }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_congo_bar_riots"

			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:BEL ?= { has_variable = cwp_congo_training }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_congo_bar_cadres"
				value = -0.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {

			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_congo_bar_force_publique"

			}
		}
	}
}

### Portuguese Africa: the liberation wars (0 to 100) and Portugal's exhaustion (0 to 100)
cwp_portugal_war_bar = {
	name = "cwp_portugal_war_bar"
	desc = "cwp_portugal_war_bar_desc"
	default_bad = yes

	start_value = 10
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		add = {
			desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_movements"
			value = 0.4
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 3
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_tide_strong"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_tide_tier
				global_var:cwp_tide_tier >= 4
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_tide_total"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:CNG ?= { is_subject = no }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_zaire"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:TNZ ?= { is_subject = no }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_tanzania"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:RUS ?= { has_variable = cwp_champions_self_determination }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_soviet_arms"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= { has_variable = cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_counter_insurgency"
				value = -1.5
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= { has_variable = cwp_portugal_colonatos }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_bar_colonatos"
				value = -0.3
			}
		}
	}
}

cwp_portugal_exhaustion_bar = {
	name = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_bar"
	desc = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_bar_desc"
	default_bad = yes

	start_value = 0
	min_value = 0
	max_value = 100

	monthly_progress = {
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_portugal_war_level
				global_var:cwp_portugal_war_level >= 1
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_war"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = cwp_portugal_war_level
				global_var:cwp_portugal_war_level >= 2
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_war_heavy"
				value = 0.4
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= { has_variable = cwp_portugal_counter_insurgency }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_conscription"
				value = 0.2
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= { scaled_debt > 0.5 }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_bar_metropole_debt"
				value = 0.3
			}
		}
		progress_condition = {
			limit = {
				c:POR ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law = law_type:law_autocracy
						has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "cwp_portugal_exhaustion_censorship"
				value = -0.2
			}
		}
	}
}
